map.单缝夫琅禾费衍射暗纹（本页代码口径，含缝宽）：a×sinθ=m×λ，即 sinθ: Single-slit Fraunhofer diffraction minima (page convention, includes slit width): a*sin(theta) = m*lambda, i.e. sin(theta) = m*lambda/a (a = slit width in m, lambda = wavelength in m, m = dark-fringe order and must be a non-zero integer); dark-fringe angle theta = arcsin(m*lambda/a)*180/pi (deg), first dark-fringe angle theta1 = arcsin(lambda/a)*180/pi. Validation: slit width a and wavelength lambda must be greater than 0, the order m must be a non-zero integer (order 0 is the central bright fringe), and |m*lambda/a| > 1 reports that the order is not observable. Criterion: no fixed grading; the narrower the slit, the larger the dark-fringe angle (stronger diffraction); the half-angular width of the central bright fringe equals the first dark-fringe angle theta1.
